corpus_defect_notes: Coverage-audit correction: added f26, a task-critical fact for 'summarize the discussion about user interface design' that was missing — the Project Manager's question about how the remote reports its state back to the user, and the Industrial Designer's confirmation that this could not be done because a user-history system could not be implemented, which is the actual problem the light-indicator-on-the-stick idea (f12) was proposed to solve. Also fixed r2: it previously claimed the ten-digits-vs-voice-recognition tradeoff 'was resolved in favor of voice recognition,' which overstated the evidence (span:1 ends on the battery-life drawback with no final decision stated) and directly contradicted f23's own 'unresolved_question' categorization of the same exchange.
